title: Invocation parameter JSON contract design and fault-reconciliation playbook
creator: Anika Rao
description: Goal: Define a canonical JSON-based parameter contract for function/tool invocation that is compact, runtime-friendly, and compatible with legacy LLM outputs. Deliver a validation surface, error taxonomy, and reconciliation behaviors (auto-repair/shims) to reduce class of failures that reach application code. Scope includes: schema expressiveness for typed fields, optional/required semantics, variant unions, KV cache pins, streaming partial-validation, and a small set of machine-readable error codes plus human-friendly messages. Out of scope: end-to-end UI for user corrections (handled by UX ticket), deep natural-language heuristics for free-form text fields (defer to fuzzy-adaptor work).
acceptance_criteria: 1) Spec document (this ticket) reviewed and approved by runtime, SDK, and security; 2) Validator library implemented with the following modes: strict, permissive-with-hints, and streaming-partial; 3) Error taxonomy defined and mapped to telemetry events; 4) Compatibility shim documented that retries with lenient coercion when safe; 5) Integration tests for 10 canonical failure cases + rollout plan for gradual enablement in hosted API.
architecture_notes:
Design principles:
- Compact, non-verbose schema: prefer short keywords (type, req, alt) to reduce token overhead when schemas are embedded in prompts.
- Deterministic validator: same input always produces same error/state so SDKs can memoize repair attempts.
- Graceful compatibility: introduce a 'compatibilityProfile' field that signals which legacy behaviors are accepted (e.g., allow_missing_arrays, coerce_numbers_from_strings).

Example minimal schema (illustrative):
{
  "schema_version": "1.0",
  "name": "create_event",
  "params": [{
    "name": "title",
    "type": "string",
    "req": true
  },{
    "name": "start_ts",
    "type": "integer",
    "req": true
  },{
    "name": "tags",
    "type": "array<string>",
    "req": false
  },{
    "name": "metadata",
    "type": "object",
    "req": false
  }],
  "compatibilityProfile": "legacy-v1"
}

Runtime validator modes:
- strict: rejects any mismatch with canonical error codes.
- permissive-with-hints: attempts safe coercions (string->number when digits-only, single item -> array) and returns a repair suggestion.
- streaming-partial: validates fields as tokens/parts arrive and yields early diagnostics for low-latency flows.

Error taxonomy (short):
- ERR_MISSING_REQUIRED (recoverable: user/agent must supply)
- ERR_TYPE_MISMATCH (auto-repair possible in permissive mode)
- ERR_EXTRA_FIELDS (non-fatal; strip or warn)
- ERR_AMBIGUOUS_UNION (requires disambiguation hint)

Telemetry mapping: each validation event emits {event: "param.validation", code: <ERR_*>, mode: <mode>, repaired: true/false, duration_ms: <n>} (schema for telemetry lives in runtime-telemetry PR).

implementation_notes:
- Keep validator as independent library with stable public surface so Dedicated and Private can consume without pulling entire runtime.
- Ensure small on-disk schema representation (gzip-friendly) so we can embed in prompts for model-side schema negotiation.
- Avoid heuristic magic in core validator; provide a pluggable hook for fuzzy-adaptor modules that live in a separate package.
